name: usesmileid-sample-expo
description: The UseSmileID Expo sample app shell: entry point, navigation host, native configuration and the registry SDK dependency.

pinRationale.@react-native/jest-preset: Required by peer from both react-native and jest-expo, and matched to the react-native version.
pinRationale.@react-native/metro-config: Exactly 0.86.3: react-native-worklets requires it at the react-native version, and Expo's map offers 0.87 which fails that peer.
pinRationale.@smileid/sample-ui: The shared UI, by workspace link. Never published, and this is the only workspace: range in the app — the SDK below is always a registry version.
pinRationale.@smileid/usesmileid: The SDK, pinned exactly from the npm registry so every bump arrives as a PR and is therefore a free consumption test.
pinRationale.@smileid/usesmileid_mlkit_document: Document analyzer for Android targets with Google services; ships the config plugin that sets the Kotlin and KSP versions its AAR needs.
pinRationale.@smileid/usesmileid_mlkit_face: Face analyzer for Android targets with Google services; same config-plugin requirement.
pinRationale.@smileid/usesmileid_vision_document: Document analyzer for iOS, backed by the Vision framework.
pinRationale.@smileid/usesmileid_vision_face: Face analyzer for iOS, backed by the Vision framework.
pinRationale.@testing-library/react-native: Renders the shell wiring the three tab screens depend on, which tsc and eslint cannot check.
pinRationale.@types/jest: Matched to the jest 29 family below.
pinRationale.expo: SDK 57, which the SDK release notes name as the version 12.1.1 is built and verified against.
pinRationale.expo-brightness: Required SDK peer: capture raises screen brightness so a face is lit evenly.
pinRationale.expo-camera: The token scanner's camera and QR reader, pinned by Expo to the SDK 57 wave; the host owns this camera, never the SDK's.
pinRationale.expo-clipboard: The scan sheet's Paste, which reads the clipboard the host owns; pinned by Expo to the SDK 57 wave.
pinRationale.expo-constants: Reads the app manifest, which is where the shell gets its own version for the Settings footer.
pinRationale.expo-doctor: Pinned so the gate cannot start failing on a check that appeared between runs; it is what keeps continuous native generation and the SDK's expected dependency versions honest.
pinRationale.expo-file-system: Required SDK peer: captured images are written to disk before submission.
pinRationale.expo-font: Loads the five bundled DM Sans faces the type ramp resolves against.
pinRationale.expo-image-manipulator: Required SDK peer: crops and resizes captures to the submission targets.
pinRationale.expo-image-picker: Required SDK peer: the document gallery-upload path.
pinRationale.expo-keep-awake: Required SDK peer: the device must not sleep mid-capture.
pinRationale.expo-linking: Parses the cold-start URL that carries the launch arguments, which is this platform's mechanism per spec/launch-args.json.
pinRationale.expo-navigation-bar: Restyles the Android navigation bar when the Dark mode switch flips; edge to edge keeps the style it launched with.
pinRationale.expo-router: The navigation host; its file routes are what the expo column of spec/routes.json names.
pinRationale.expo-screen-orientation: Required SDK peer: document capture locks orientation.
pinRationale.expo-secure-store: Where the scanned token lives: a bearer credential goes in the Keychain or Keystore, never beside the switches in AsyncStorage.
pinRationale.expo-status-bar: Status-bar style per theme, which the contrast predicate asserts in both presentations.
pinRationale.expo-system-ui: Sets the window background so dark mode has no white flash behind a translucent screen.
pinRationale.jest: 29.7.0, not 30: jest-expo 57 depends on the jest 29 family, and the library package pins the same pair.
pinRationale.jest-expo: Versioned with the Expo SDK; supplies the React Native transform and module mocks.
pinRationale.lottie-react-native: Required SDK peer: the capture instruction animations.
pinRationale.react: Exactly 19.2.3, the floor react-native 0.86.3 declares; 19.2.0 fails that peer.
pinRationale.react-native: 0.86.3, the version the SDK release notes pair with Expo SDK 57.
pinRationale.react-native-gesture-handler: expo-router peer; also what gives sheets and swipes the platform's own gestures rather than hand-rolled ones.
pinRationale.react-native-nitro-modules: Required SDK peer: the runtime behind quick-crypto's native request signing.
pinRationale.react-native-quick-base64: Required SDK peer: native request signing.
pinRationale.react-native-quick-crypto: Required SDK peer: native request signing.
pinRationale.react-native-reanimated: expo-router peer; version 4 splits its worklets runtime into the package below.
pinRationale.react-native-safe-area-context: Required SDK peer, and how bottom-chrome clearance is measured from real insets.
pinRationale.react-native-screens: expo-router peer; gives each route a native container so the back affordance stays the platform's.
pinRationale.react-native-svg: Required SDK peer, and what the design's own marks are drawn as.
pinRationale.react-native-worklets: Reanimated 4's worklets runtime, and the reason babel.config.js carries its plugin last.
pinRationale.test-renderer: The modern replacement react-test-renderer became; @testing-library/react-native 14 requires it by peer.
pinRationale.typescript: 6.0.3, the version Expo SDK 57 expects. It also satisfies typescript-eslint 8's `>=4.8.4 <6.1.0`, so type-aware linting stays on — 7.x would not.
pinRationale.zustand: The app-lifetime stores, per the navigation plan's per-platform choice; screen state stays in hooks.
